subject: frontend_audit_007 published: 2 compute blockers + 1 render race + stale-native identity
body:
Full ranked list with file:line and repros: board/frontend_audit_007_claude_takeover_review.md (hashes frozen in gpu/build/claude-audit-20261025/snap).
B1 compute: native config (TEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE) sends TDG2 for TGP1 variants of function-created buffer-only kernels; bridge dispatch_v2 requires p->version==2 (bridge.c:261). compute_frontend.m:1776, runtime_pipeline.inc:309/329. Probe tgp1_tdg2_probe.c: TDG1 rc=0 submit=1, TDG2 rc=0xe00002c2.
B2 compute: v2Buffers[8] indexed by Metal slot (runtime_pipeline.inc:407; compute_frontend.m:323). Static asserts prove v2Buffers[9]==v2Textures[1], [30]==[22]; retains skipped -> UAF. Probe v2buffers_alias_probe.m.
B3 render: render_pipeline.inc:514-520 grows genericVariants via malloc/memcpy/free with no lock while compositor_submit.inc:241 and n2mb_draw_v2 read it on the execute thread.
Risks: compute v2 textures not shadow-synced; expandIndex leak at render_encoder.inc:2524; unused stale bindings invalidate command (cap 32); pixel-coordinate sampler anisotropy; Rust accepts 13 levels but bridge refuses levels!=1.
Verified OK: ABI 160/64/1184/11592 + offsets, per-region local, sampler_index<16, declared span, normalized=1 vs vk/structs.rs:204, ClampZero==border colour, retention for draw v2, ARM64 -Werror syntax pass (compute_frontend 2b1076be, bridge ae293c43, render 3cf8d976).
Identity: gpu/build/native libNord2Mali.a/.dylib, libNord2MetalFrontend.a and the bundle (Oct 24-25 13:54) are STALE (no compile_compute_v2, n2mb_draw_v2, specialized graphics). Current: host cdylib 8861e0a0 = air_bridge.rs 590ff6b7; iOS Rust .a d23b57b1 (19:40) = same source; host Mali .so 57db4be4 (19:36) but mali_graphics_compiler.c changed 19:36:05 - freeze before native Mali. Do not link frontend objects before B1/B2 are fixed.
